integrity: The invariant-law theorem is proved analytically; finite graph algebra and one stochastic diagnostic are independently replayable from the included script. No claim of independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for finite connected undirected weighted graphs, a single Poisson-reset vertex, constant forcing, and a real-valued unwrapped linear phase system. No inference to the nonlinear Kuramoto flow or to several simultaneously reset vertices.
title: Frequency-shape universality at finite Poisson resetting rate on connected oscillator networks
